thought.text: Let me investigate why mfe-ws fails standalone but succeeded in the main build:

reasoning_content:
mfe-ws standalone Dockerfile: `npm ci --workspace mfe-ws --workspace shared --include-workspace-root=false`, then `npm run -w shared build`, then `npm run -w mfe-ws build`. Error: Rollup can't resolve "shared/style.css" from mfe-ws/src/main.tsx.

In the main frontend build (staged frontend), mfe-ws built fine (the main frontend image has mfe-ws dist + injector). The difference: the standalone Dockerfile's workspace install… Let me check: is shared/dist present in the standalone build? `npm run -w shared build` runs before the mfe-ws build. The resolution of "shared/style.css" depends on the shared package's "exports" or "main" pointing at dist/style.css. If shared's build didn't produce dist/style.css, resolution fails.

Wait — in the main frontend, the same steps: `npm run build:shared` then the parallel builds — and mfe-ws succeeded there. The difference in the standalone Dockerfile: after `COPY . .`? Let me look at mfe-ws's Dockerfile again:

```
COPY package.json package-lock.json ./
COPY shared/package.json shared/package.json
COPY mfe-ws/package.json mfe-ws/package.json
RUN npm ci --workspace mfe-ws --workspace shared --include-workspace-root=false
COPY . .
RUN npm run -w shared build
RUN npm run -w mfe-ws build
```

Hmm, wait, the earlier mfe-ewm Dockerfile had the same shape. mfe-ewm and mfe-fp succeeded. Why does mfe-ws fail on "shared/style.css"?

Maybe mfe-ws's source imports "shared/style.css", but in the main build this got resolved because of a different vite alias config… no wait, in the main frontend mfe-ws built fine (the main image includes mfe-ws dist + injector).

What's different between the main build and the standalone? In the main, `npm ci` installed all workspaces; in the standalone, only mfe-ws + shared. Resolution of "shared/style.css": via the `shared` package in node_modules (symlink to the workspace). The workspace's package.json probably has "exports" or a "style" field. If shared's package.json maps "./style.css" to "dist/style.css" and shared's build (tsc + css copy?) generated dist/style.css…

Hmm wait — in the main build, shared was built with `npm run build:shared` = `npm run build --workspace=shared`. Same as standalone's `npm run -w shared build`.

Let me look at the actual error more carefully: Rollup failed to resolve "shared/style.css" from mfe-ws/src/main.tsx. In the main build, mfe-ws/src/main.tsx should be the same file… and it resolved. Difference: node_modules state. With `--include-workspace-root=false`, npm ci installed deps only for mfe-ws + shared. Maybe mfe-ws depends on some package (vite-tsconfig-paths or something) that's declared in another workspace's package.json (e.g., the root devDeps or shared's devDeps)… no, mfe-ws's own devDeps include vite etc.

Wait — maybe the difference is a missing shared/dist/style.css: in the standalone, was `npm run -w shared build` actually executed? Line: "RUN npm run -w shared build" — check the log. Let me look at the mfe-ws log around the shared build. Actually, let me first check shared/package.json's build script and whether dist/style.css is produced. And check whether the mfe-ws build in the main frontend log had the same Rollup error but it was tolerated?? No — the main image includes mfe-ws/dist, so it succeeded.

Hmm, actually wait: in the main build, mfe-ws's build:release = "npm run build" = "npm run api-gen && vite build". The same command in standalone. And it succeeded in main.

The only difference: which workspaces got node_modules installed. mfe-ws's deps might resolve "shared/style.css" via `imports` in shared/package.json? Let me investigate: shared/package.json's exports + mfe-ws's vite config + main.tsx imports. And compare node_modules/.package-lock or installed tree. Easiest way: reproduce locally in a container — run the standalone steps and debug. Let me quickly look at shared/package.json and mfe-ws's src/main.tsx imports.

action.command: cd /workspace/01-frontend && cat shared/package.json | head -30; echo "=== mfe-ws main.tsx imports:"; grep -n 'shared' mfe-ws/src/main.tsx; echo "=== mfe-ws Dockerfile build steps:"; sed -n '1,30p' mfe-ws/Dockerfile | grep -n 'RUN\|COPY'

summary: Inspect shared package and mfe-ws imports
